description: Per-job resource accounting for IREN_MKZ GB300. Canonical owner of per-job placement, per-tray accounting and per-GPU detail. Fault triage for the same job lives on Job Health.

options.content:
Job Stats — placement and resources for one job

The tray set for the selected Job ID is resolved from cgroup_info published by the Slurm cgroup exporter on every tray; GPU and host series are then restricted to exactly those trays. Each tile below is backed by the table under it — row count for counts, column total for sums. Faults for this job live on Job Health.
Job StatsJob Health — fault triageJobs & Cluster homeCross-domain impact

panels.title: Job footprint and resource totals — every number below is a column total of the table beneath

panels.description: Distinct trays that hosted a cgroup for this job inside the dashboard time range. Equals the row count of “Every tray in this job” below.
panels.title: Trays in job

panels.description: GPUs reporting DCGM on the job's trays. Equals the row count of “Per-GPU detail” below and the GPUs total in the per-tray table. A tray that has stopped reporting since the job ran contributes 0.

targets.expr: sum(((count by(node,rack,su)(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP and on(instance) max by(instance)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) and count by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or (0 * count by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))))) or vector(0)

panels.title: GPUs in job

panels.description: Equals the row count of “Racks and SUs this job spans”.
panels.title: Racks spanned

panels.description: Sum of cgroup RSS across the job's trays (last sample in range). Equals the Resident memory total in the per-tray table.

targets.expr: sum(((sum by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_memory_rss_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",cgroup=~".*job_$jobid"}[$__range])) and count by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or (0 * count by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Job resident memory

panels.description: CPU core-hours consumed by the job's cgroups over the dashboard range. Equals the CPU core-hours total in the per-tray table.

targets.expr: sum(((sum by(node,rack,su)(increase(cgroup_cpu_total_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster",cgroup=~".*job_$jobid"}[$__range])) and count by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or (0 * count by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))))) / 3600 or vector(0)

panels.title: Job CPU time in range (core-hours)

panels.description: Sum of DCGM board power over every GPU on this job's trays, at the latest scrape. DCGM cannot attribute power to a Slurm job, so if the job has finished this reads the trays' current draw rather than the job's. Equals the GPU power column total of the table below.

targets.expr: sum(((sum by(node,rack,su)(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE and on(instance) max by(instance)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) and count by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or (0 * count by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))))) or vector(0)

panels.title: GPU power on the job's trays

panels.description: Exactly which trays this job landed on and what each one is consuming. Same selector as the tiles above; every column total in the footer row is one of the tiles. A tray showing 0 GPUs and 0 W has stopped reporting telemetry since it ran this job.

defaults.noValue: No cgroup for this job on any tray in the selected range

targets.expr: ((count by(node,rack,su)(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP and on(instance) max by(instance)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) and count by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or (0 * count by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))))

((sum by(node,rack,su)(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE and on(instance) max by(instance)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) and count by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or (0 * count by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: L2 · Every tray in this job — rows = “Trays in job”, column totals = the tiles above

panels.description: Rack-level footprint of the job. A job spread over many racks pays the inter-rack fabric cost on every collective. The GPUs and GPU power totals are the tiles above.

defaults.noValue: No cgroup for this job on any tray in the selected range

targets.expr: ((count by(rack,su)(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP and on(instance) max by(instance)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) and count by(rack,su)(count by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range])))) or (0 * count by(rack,su)(count by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range])))))

((sum by(rack,su)(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE and on(instance) max by(instance)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) and count by(rack,su)(count by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range])))) or (0 * count by(rack,su)(count by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range])))))

panels.title: L2 · Racks and SUs this job spans — rows = “Racks spanned”
The job's GPUs — DCGM on the trays the job is running on

panels.description: A persistent gap between min and max is a straggler rank.
panels.title: GPU utilisation — min / avg / max across the job's GPUs

panels.description: Sustained ~600 W per GPU is real training; a flat low line is idle or blocked on a collective.
panels.title: GPU power — min / avg / max across the job's GPUs

panels.description: Sensor values of 150 °C and above are DCGM's not-available sentinel and are excluded.
panels.title: GPU temperature — chip and HBM

panels.description: DCGM reports framebuffer in MiB; converted to bytes here.
panels.title: GPU framebuffer in use — avg / max per GPU

panels.description: Every GPU this job is using. Filter the Tray column to isolate a rank.

defaults.noValue: No GPU telemetry on this job's trays in the selected range

panels.title: L2 · Per-GPU detail — rows = “GPUs in job”, hottest first
Host resources on the job's trays — node exporter

panels.description: Ranked independently at every point in time, so more than ten trays can appear across the window. Every tray of the job is listed in the table at the foot of this page.
panels.title: Tray CPU busy — the 10 busiest trays at each point

panels.description: Ranked independently at every point in time, so more than ten trays can appear across the window. Every tray of the job is listed in the table at the foot of this page.

targets.expr: topk(10, (1 - avg by(node)(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes and on(instance) max by(instance)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) / avg by(node)(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes and on(instance) max by(instance)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range])))) * 100)

panels.title: Tray memory used — the 10 heaviest trays at each point
Local disk throughput — job total
Local disk IOPS — job total

panels.description: Should be flat zero. Any sustained rate means shared storage is stalling the job.
panels.title: NFS RPC retransmissions — job trays

panels.description: One row per tray in the job — the row count equals the “Trays in job” tile. Silent for is the age of that tray's newest node-exporter sample; when it is over 5 minutes the tray has stopped answering and its load, memory and I/O cells are blank because there is no current reading, not because they are zero.

targets.expr: max by(node,rack,su)((1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes) * 100 and on(instance) max by(instance)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range])))

((min by(node,rack,su)((time() - tlast_over_time(up{job=~"node|node-exporter"}[$__range])) and on(instance) max by(instance)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) and count by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))) or (0 * count by(node,rack,su)(last_over_time(cgroup_info{cluster=~"$cluster",jobid=~"$jobid"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: L2 · Host pressure per tray — rows = “Trays in job”, silent trays first
